source_conflicts.detail: P1 reports champion PCE 20.78% for a MAPbI3 mesoscopic device (0.50 cm2); P2 reports only a 15-device PCE distribution for FAMA/CsFAMA films (0.14 cm2 active area). P1 itself states that efficiencies should not be compared across studies that differ in absorber, architecture and area. The two PCE values are therefore recorded per source and NOT ranked.
The generic term "perovskite" denotes MAPbI3 in P1 and FA0.9MA0.1PbI2.85Br0.15 / Cs0.05FA0.90MA0.05PbI2.85Br0.15 in P2; treated as distinct samples, never as one material instance.
P2 "R2 > 0.9" is the coefficient of determination of the DL model on simulated kinetic parameters, not a device performance metric; it must not be compared with P1 device PCE/Voc/FF.
"passivation" in P1 denotes bulk COF additive defect passivation inside the MAPbI3 film; in P2 it denotes a surface passivation solution spin-coated on cooled films. Same word, different procedure.

uncertainty.detail: P2 device PCE is presented only as a box/distribution plot (15 devices); no single numeric PCE is stated in the body text, so no PCE node value was extracted for P2.
P1 aging conditions (illumination, humidity, encapsulation) for the 500 h retention are not specified in the cited paragraph; only retention fractions were extracted.
No paper compares its devices against the other paper; no cross-paper outperforms relation is asserted.
